decisions.reason: As a small extension of the firm’s established track system, it likely meets modest aspirations and is easy to carry in a growing market with some portfolio slack.
This LED luminaire is close to the core offer, so without clear signs of failure a premium lighting firm would usually retain it, though normal assortment renewal creates some risk.

The home automation server box is more uncertain and somewhat further from the firm’s strongest lighting competences, so if results fell short of aspirations management would be more likely to reallocate resources.

A luminaire family fits the firm’s established premium assortment and retailer-showroom model, so in the absence of negative evidence management would more likely keep it than search for alternatives.
